steps.title: Open the home page
steps.narration: Let's start on Trendora's home page — a small status pill up top tells you at a glance whether today's board of rankings can be trusted.
steps.point_out: The status pill reads 'Ready' with a thin green banner underneath saying 'GO — today's board is current,' even right after the app restarts.

steps.title: Open the Data Manager
steps.narration: The Data Manager page is where the dataset's day-by-day coverage lives, and where new historical days get pulled in.
steps.point_out: The Dataset coverage panel shows real numbers for price history, universe size, and trading days — all computed and stored ahead of time, never recalculated while you wait.

steps.title: Enter a backfill start date
steps.narration: Typing a start date into the backfill form begins a request to fill in a specific day's data.

steps.title: Enter a backfill end date
steps.narration: The end date completes the range — here it's just the next calendar day.

steps.title: Start the backfill job
steps.narration: Clicking Start submits the request. Because this short span falls on a weekend and was already covered by an earlier run, Trendora is upfront about it instead of pretending something new happened.
steps.point_out: The job status reads 'no new snapshots' — a distinct, honest outcome, never dressed up as a fresh success.

steps.title: Back to the Data Manager
steps.narration: Back on the Data Manager page to try a much larger date range.

steps.title: Enter a much wider date range
steps.narration: Setting the start date over a year back sets up a much bigger backfill request.

steps.title: Enter the range's end date
steps.narration: The end date extends the span past 400 days — well beyond what a size-capped system would allow.

steps.title: Start the large backfill
steps.narration: Trendora accepts the whole range at once — no 'range too large' rejection — and works through it so even a very large request finishes cleanly.
steps.point_out: The Data Manager reports the full 412-calendar-day span was accepted and processed, proving there's no hidden per-run size cap.

steps.title: Browse the Scanner Runs history
steps.narration: Every day the scanner has run lives here as a dated, unchanging snapshot.
steps.point_out: The most recent run appears immediately with its stored results — no loading skeleton, no recomputation needed.

steps.title: Open a scan from years ago
steps.narration: Clicking into a much older date opens the exact view the scanner produced back then — instantly, because it was already computed and stored at the time.
steps.point_out: The page reads 'as of 2021-09-15' and renders its full leaderboard immediately, proving these results are never recalculated on the spot.
